### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

### / Lodestar

#### Ethereum Consensus Client

LODESTAR'S TOOLS AND LIBRARIES ENABLE ETHEREUM PROTOCOL DEVELOPMENT FOR THE JAVASCRIPT ECOSYSTEM
with RUST AND ZIG NATIVE LIBRARIES ENSURing PERFORMANT AND EFFICIENT EXECUTION.

Run your own full node to ensure your independence while validating with a top performing client.

Make Ethereum safer without sacrificing efficiency.

[Lodestar, Ethereum client logo, yellow diamond-shaped geometric logo with a small square cutout in
the center.][
Explore Lodestar
Explore Lodestar

### / Forest

#### Filecoin Protocol Engineering Team

The Forest team is made up of Filecoin protocol engineering EXPERTS, who have long contributed to
the Filecoin ecosystem, including developing the Filecoin Virtual Machine, FIP implementations, and
native actors development.

Forest is a Rust implementation of the Filecoin protocol, offering fast performance with minimal
hardware requirements. validate and access chain data, run an RPC node, generate snapshots, and
manage FIL with a built-in wallet.

[Forest Filecoin client logo, three green stylized pine trees arranged in a triangular formation on
a transparent background.][
Explore Forest
Explore Forest
][15]

### / Gossamer

#### Polkadot Protocol Engineering Team

The Gossamer team is made up of experienced Polkadot core developers who have contributed to the
network’s evolution since its early days. Including work on Node Implementations, Parachain
Infrastructure, and new initiatives like JAM.

Gossamer is a modular framework for building and running Polkadot nodes in Go.

Whether you’re running a parachain or building a custom network, Gossamer provides the Go-tooling to
get started fast.

[Gossamer Polkadot client logo, stylized magenta geometric hexagon with intersecting lines and
central hexagonal shape on black background.][
Explore Gossamer
Explore Gossamer
][16]

### / Optimism

#### Optimism Rust OP-Supervisor

As a crosschain safety service for the OP Stack, the OP-Supervisor validates messages and tracks
block safety across the Superchain.

acting as a trusted L1 data source, the Op-supervisor manages rollup sync and verification, handles
re-orgs, and ensures state consistency. it’s designed to keep chain interoperability safe, smooth,
and ready to scale.

community drive innovations forward.

prototyped, tested, and scaled reality.

### Hashgraph accelerates institutional tokenization with Asseto

Hashgraph today announced the availability of Asseto, a modular tokenization platform developed by
ioBuilders on Hedera and HashSphere. The platform enables financial institutions to issue, manage,
trade, and settle tokenized financial assets through a single integrated solution.
[ Discover More ][55]
[Three Major Announcements At HederaCon]
May 4, 2026

### Hashgraph unveils three major announcements at HederaCon in Miami

New cross-ledger protocol, general availability of the HashSphere private network, and an investment
in digital asset provider ioBuilders
[ Discover More ][56]

## A private interoperable network

As an EVM-compatible private network, HashSphere is built to connect seamlessly to other private
networks, the Hedera public network and even other public chains—so your assets are never trapped
and you’re never locked into a single vendor.

Available as a managed service offering or fully-hosted infrastructure, HashSphere users benefit
from Hedera infrastructure in a private network setting with SLAs and 24/5 support.

[ Discover More ][57]

Hedera at the core

## HashSphere is powered by Hedera

With its fast, scalable, and compliant architecture, Hedera is ideal for regulated industries where
performance and compliance matter.
* **Deterministic finality in seconds: **Designed for trust and compliance, all network transactions
  are finalized in under 3 seconds and can’t be reversed.
* **Fast:** Hashgraph technology enables the Hedera network to process more than 10,000 transactions
  per second.
* **Fair by design:** Transactions are ordered by consensus timestamps, ensuring fair sequencing and
  built-in resistance to front running.

[ Discover More ][58]

## Behind the Ledger: Transaction Privacy in HashSphere

Privacy on a DLT doesn’t have to mean a trusted operator in the middle.This first installment of
this series breaks down how HashSphere delivers atomic settlement without exposure; keeping
counterparty identities, amounts, and balances cryptographically hidden across every transaction
type.

[ Discover More ][59]

## What makes HashSphere unique

Natively Event-Driven

#### Hashgraph consensus powers HashSphere

Unlike other private, permissioned networks on the market, HashSphere consensus timestamps cannot be
manipulated. It’s based on the hashgraph consensus algorithm where all nodes deterministically reach
the same result, ensuring fair sequencing and built-in resistance to front running.

Choose your own validators

#### You control the governance model

The validator set is chosen by the stand-alone private network, which is not a subnet on a public
network. There is no central routing party, the network chooses its own governance model. And the
network is built on standard EVM infrastructure, compatible with the broader ecosystem of tooling,
custody, and development talent.

Transaction Privacy

#### In network transaction confidentiality

Transaction privacy is enforced cryptographically through zkSNARKs and encrypted balance, so no
party, including the network operator, can see transaction content. Transactions settle in under 3-5
seconds and are mathematically guaranteed with hashgraph consensus fair ordering.

# Building the fabric of the digital economy

As a growing enterprise software company, Hashgraph is building the future of finance through
products and solutions developed with Hedera technology.

[ Contact Us ][52]

featured content

## The latest news and events from Hashgraph

[ View All ][53]
June 30, 2026

### Behind the Ledger Part 1: Transaction Privacy in HashSphere

A technical deep-dive into how HashSphere delivers transaction privacy through cryptographic
enforcement, not policy.
[ Discover More ][54]
[Asseto]
June 3, 2026

### Hashgraph accelerates institutional tokenization with Asseto

Hashgraph today announced the availability of Asseto, a modular tokenization platform developed by
ioBuilders on Hedera and HashSphere. The platform enables financial institutions to issue, manage,
trade, and settle tokenized financial assets through a single integrated solution.
[ Discover More ][55]
[Three Major Announcements At HederaCon]
May 4, 2026

### Hashgraph unveils three major announcements at HederaCon in Miami

New cross-ledger protocol, general availability of the HashSphere private network, and an investment
in digital asset provider ioBuilders
[ Discover More ][56]

## A private interoperable network

As an EVM-compatible private network, HashSphere is built to connect seamlessly to other private
networks, the Hedera public network and even other public chains—so your assets are never trapped
and you’re never locked into a single vendor.

Available as a managed service offering or fully-hosted infrastructure, HashSphere users benefit
from Hedera infrastructure in a private network setting with SLAs and 24/5 support.

[ Discover More ][57]

Hedera at the core

## HashSphere is powered by Hedera

With its fast, scalable, and compliant architecture, Hedera is ideal for regulated industries where
performance and compliance matter.
* **Deterministic finality in seconds: **Designed for trust and compliance, all network transactions
  are finalized in under 3 seconds and can’t be reversed.
* **Fast:** Hashgraph technology enables the Hedera network to process more than 10,000 transactions
  per second.
* **Fair by design:** Transactions are ordered by consensus timestamps, ensuring fair sequencing and
  built-in resistance to front running.

[ Discover More ][58]

## Behind the Ledger: Transaction Privacy in HashSphere

Privacy on a DLT doesn’t have to mean a trusted operator in the middle.This first installment of
this series breaks down how HashSphere delivers atomic settlement without exposure; keeping
counterparty identities, amounts, and balances cryptographically hidden across every transaction
type.

[ Discover More ][59]

## What makes HashSphere unique

Natively Event-Driven

#### Hashgraph consensus powers HashSphere

Unlike other private, permissioned networks on the market, HashSphere consensus timestamps cannot be
manipulated. It’s based on the hashgraph consensus algorithm where all nodes deterministically reach
the same result, ensuring fair sequencing and built-in resistance to front running.

Choose your own validators

#### You control the governance model

The validator set is chosen by the stand-alone private network, which is not a subnet on a public
network. There is no central routing party, the network chooses its own governance model. And the
network is built on standard EVM infrastructure, compatible with the broader ecosystem of tooling,
custody, and development talent.

Transaction Privacy

#### In network transaction confidentiality

Transaction privacy is enforced cryptographically through zkSNARKs and encrypted balance, so no
party, including the network operator, can see transaction content. Transactions settle in under 3-5
seconds and are mathematically guaranteed with hashgraph consensus fair ordering.

end-to-end digital asset management solution

## Issue, manage and trade tokenized financial assets 

Developed by [ioBuilders][60], Asseto is now offered by Hashgraph and gives financial institutions
one modular platform to issue, manage, and trade tokenized instruments and digital cash, backed by
the private HashSphere network or the public Hedera network.

[ Request a Demo ][61]

## Introducing CLPR–a new Cross-Ledger Protocol

CLPR (pronounced “clipper”) moves value natively between ledgers cryptographically–without
intermediaries and bridges. It enables interoperability between private network Spheres, the Hedera
public network and even other public networks outside of the Hedera ecosystem to unlock greater
sources of liquidity.

[ Discover More ][62]

Real-world use cases

## HashSphere in action

MODERNIZING PROPERTY RISK DATA FOR THE INSURANCE INDUSTRY

### The Institutes RiskStream Collaborative

The Institutes RiskStream Collaborative is the insurance industry’s largest not-for-profit emerging
technology consortium, bringing together carriers, brokers, and reinsurers to solve shared data
challenges.

[ Learn More ][63]
ADVANCING COMPLIANT ASSET-BACKED FINANCE

### QFC Digital Asset Lab

HashSphere is the foundation for Blade Labs’ blockchain-based Digital Receipt System (DRS)
proof-of-concept deployed in collaboration with Qatar Financial Centre’s Digital Asset Lab.

[ Learn More ][64]
ADVANCING WHOLESALE TOKENIZED MARKETS

### Project Acacia

Project Acacia explores how different forms of digital money and associated infrastructure could
support the development of wholesale tokenized asset markets in Australia.

[ Learn More ][65]

See what others are saying

## Trusted for the real world

“At QFC, we are committed to building a strong digital asset ecosystem that supports innovation and
real-world applications. This initiative reflects our continued support for tokenisation, financial
innovation, and collaboration aligned with the Third Financial Sector Strategic Plan.”

Yousup Mohamed Al-Jaida

CEO, QFC

[ Read More ][66]

“The Digital Receipt System POC will showcase that blockchain, smart contracts, and global identity
standards can address the operational bottlenecks that currently prevent Islamic finance
institutions from scaling certain Shariah-compliant asset-backed products.”

Sami Mian

CEO, Blade Labs

“We’re aiming to leverage HashSphere to verify, track, and maintain critical data over time across
multiple insurance parties. The vision is to tokenize risk assets to create a persistent, unique
identifier that serves as a shared data foundation for the risk management and insurance industry.”

Patrick G. Schmid, Ph.D

President of The Institutes RiskStream Collaborative

Hedera Ecosystem

## Independent organizations sit at the core of the Hedera ecosystem

At the center of the Hedera network is a collaboration of independent entities: Hashgraph is the
development labs team behind Hedera’s best-in-class technology and provider of HashSphere and CLPR,
the Cross-Ledger Protocol. Hedera Council is a group of up to 39 leading institutions that govern
the Hedera public network. Each entity works independently but cohesively to play a critical role in
the Hedera network’s growth.

## Ready to get started?

Reach out to the Hashgraph team to learn more.

## The foundational trust layer

Hedera powers fast, scalable, and compliant applications—it’s ideal for regulated industries where
performance and compliance matter. 

#### Stable fees in HBAR

Fees are set in USD starting at $0.0001 and automatically converted to HBAR at the time of each
transaction, so your costs stay predictable regardless of HBAR’s market price. Hedera delivers some
of the lowest and most predictable pricing in the industry.

#### Finality in seconds

Designed for trust and compliance, all network transactions are finalized in under 3 seconds and
can’t be reversed. 

#### Built-in regulatory compliance

With safeguards at both the protocol and application level, Hedera is one of the most OFAC-compliant
public networks, guided by a decentralized global Council.

#### Fast

The hashgraph technology enables parallel transaction processing, making Hedera exponentially faster
than other blockchains.

#### EVM-compatible

Hedera supports Solidity smart contracts and works seamlessly with Ethereum-based tools and
applications, including both native and ERC-compatible tokenization.

#### AI-ready

Hedera gives AI systems the trust layer they need with real-time finality, low-cost verifiability,
and tamper-proof data for autonomous agents and intelligent applications.

#### Fair by design

Transactions are ordered by consensus timestamps, ensuring fair sequencing and built-in resistance
to front running.

#### Energy-efficient

Hedera is carbon negative and uses less energy than a Visa transaction, setting a new standard for
sustainable public networks. 

## Why Hedera is the trust layer of the digital economy

Hedera combines scalable technology, institutional network governance, and built-in compliance to
provide trusted infrastructure and application services for regulated industries and beyond.

## World-leading institutions govern the network

Hedera is recognized as one of the most regulatory-compliant public DLT networks in the world today.
A rotating group of Fortune 1000 companies, institutions, non-profits, and universities operate the
Hedera network, ensuring its security, integrity, and long-term strategic direction. Hedera Council

## The foundational trust layer

Hedera powers fast, scalable, and compliant applications—it’s ideal for regulated industries where
performance and compliance matter. 

#### Stable fees in HBAR

Fees are set in USD starting at $0.0001 and automatically converted to HBAR at the time of each
transaction, so your costs stay predictable regardless of HBAR’s market price. Hedera delivers some
of the lowest and most predictable pricing in the industry.

#### Finality in seconds

Designed for trust and compliance, all network transactions are finalized in under 3 seconds and
can’t be reversed. 

#### Built-in regulatory compliance

With safeguards at both the protocol and application level, Hedera is one of the most OFAC-compliant
public networks, guided by a decentralized global Council.

#### Fast

The hashgraph technology enables parallel transaction processing, making Hedera exponentially faster
than other blockchains.

#### EVM-compatible

Hedera supports Solidity smart contracts and works seamlessly with Ethereum-based tools and
applications, including both native and ERC-compatible tokenization.

#### AI-ready

Hedera gives AI systems the trust layer they need with real-time finality, low-cost verifiability,
and tamper-proof data for autonomous agents and intelligent applications.

#### Fair by design

Transactions are ordered by consensus timestamps, ensuring fair sequencing and built-in resistance
to front running.

#### Energy-efficient

Hedera is carbon negative and uses less energy than a Visa transaction, setting a new standard for
sustainable public networks. 

## Why Hedera is the trust layer of the digital economy

Hedera combines scalable technology, institutional network governance, and built-in compliance to
provide trusted infrastructure and application services for regulated industries and beyond.

## "But..." — We've Heard It All

Every objection you have, we've addressed it with real results. Click to see the proof.

"The AI Act deadline moved — why start now?"

The high-risk deadline moved to December 2, 2027. That window is exactly why starting now is
cheaper: you spread the work over normal sprints instead of paying panic prices in late 2027 — and
you can ship AI features your competitors are still afraid to build.

"We're too small for AI"

You don't need an AI department. A focused Proof of Concept starts at €15K — less than one senior
dev's monthly salary in most EU markets. Start small, prove ROI, then scale.

"We tried AI before and it failed"

Most AI projects fail on integration and scope, not on the models. We start with a short technical
audit to identify why it failed and what to do differently — before writing any new code.

"We can't afford consultants"

You're not paying for an agency's overhead — the founder does the work. No juniors, no handoffs, no
200-page PowerPoints. You get working code, deployed to production, at a fraction of Big Four rates.

EU-native. Netherlands-registered (KVK 97732699). GDPR-compliant practices and EU AI Act
requirements are designed into every project — data residency, model governance, and regulatory
